decisions.reason: The accepted one-off first-mint exception necessarily changes the ticket reconciliation and random-allocation rules because no earlier NFT holder exists to receive that mint's ticket.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yeah, that’s fine, since it’s a one-off and won’t have any impact going forward.

value_updates.ticket_count_reconciliation_rule: One Small Block ticket is generated for every eligible primary mint, excluding secondary-market sales and the one-off first mint, which cannot award a ticket because no earlier NFT holder exists.
value_updates.no_referral_mint_ticket_allocation: When a primary mint has no referral code and at least one existing NFT holder exists, its ticket is issued at random to an existing NFT holder; the one-off first mint generates no ticket.
